payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the proposed method using reinforcement learning (RL) improves task success rate and total task reward compared to supervised training methods, but does not specify the exact magnitude of improvement.

claims.text: The proposed method leads to promising improvements on task success rate and total task reward compared to supervised training methods.
The combination of supervised learning and deep reinforcement learning improves system robustness and dialog success rate over purely supervised methods.
The iterative optimization of dialog policies with deep RL enhances the performance of both the dialog agent and user simulator beyond initial supervised training.
